snippet.title: The code has reached 100,000 lines. My indie game is finally playable!#steam #indiegame #indiedev
snippet.description:
Hello everyone, I'm Dabo.
This is a game that I developed with half a year's effort or with a few friends - "Galactic Defense Battle"!
This is a cartoon-style Roguelike tower defense game. The core gameplay is to use randomly selected heroes and equipment to build the strongest planetary defense team to resist alien invaders.
This video brings you a preview of the game's in-game demo!
If you like this game, please give it a like, share, and follow for your support. This really means a lot to us independent developers! Also, feel free to leave your valuable opinions in the comment section!
If you want to get the latest game updates or have unique suggestions for the game, you can join the discord to discuss together.
The next episode will bring you an in-game explanation. 
wish list address: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3953060/_/
 discord :https://discord.gg/Q7YhvG2u
#indiedev #indiegame #steam #Galaxy Defense War #银河守卫战
